jobs.title: Associate Brand Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description
Position Summary
The Associate Brand Manager is responsible for assisting in delivering specified business targets (volume, profit, share) through the development and execution of all brand strategies and plans, leading to profitable growth of the Constellation Brands Beer Division portfolio.  As a cross-functional team leader, the Associate Brand Manager works effectively across disciplines and develops and sustains strong and productive relationships with external partners to execute brand strategies.

Responsibilities
- Assist in the development and implementation of short and long-term marketing objectives and strategies.
- Assist Brand Manager and Consumer Insights Team in the fine tuning of brand positioning and consumer targets.
- Assist Brand Manager and relevant cross-functional teams in developing and executing integrated all-in programs.
- Participate in the creative development process and support execution of all national and local advertising campaigns across all channels.
- Lead, alongside other ABMs peers, brand business analysis, using internal and external data sources to continuously monitor business and brand health performance to ensure brand is tracking against goals.
- Lead Beer Brand Family organic social strategy and implementation, working alongside agency of record to deliver digital-first content in support of our brand & sub-brand programming.
- Leverage business analysis to recommend tactics and plan optimizations to reverse or support trends identified.
- Assist Brand Manager and Media Planning Team in the development of all media plans and initiatives, both on national and regional/local levels.
- Assist Brand Manager in working with the Retail/Trade Marketing team to develop brand promotions, helping to direct the development of all national and local consumer promotion programming at retail.
- Assist the Brand Manager and the Lifestyle & Experiential Marketing team in the identification and development of event marketing programming, which include sponsored events, charitable donations, trade related functions, etc.
- Assist the Brand Manager and On-Premise team in channel deep dive and performance analysis to inform mitigation efforts.
- Work with the Field Marketing team to ensure strategies and tactical plans are executed for all relevant local markets.
- Lead cross-functional team of R&D, Packaging, Regulatory to deliver product and packaging renovations and optimization.
- Lead day-to-day brand budget management; responsible for maintaining budgets and forecasts monthly.

Key Foundational Business & Leadership Skills
- Thought Leader  - Demonstrating industry and content expertise with the ability to pioneer new ideas, efficiently and effectively solve problems, and influence others while being open to collaboration.

- Intense Drive  - Leading with passion, enthusiasm, and a sense of urgency that influences others to follow suit, with self-motivation to achieve goals and challenge the status quo.
- Constantly Innovating  - Developing and encouraging creative ideas that challenge common thinking and help CBI gain a competitive advantage while being open and agile to adapt, change, and try new things to promote growth, learning, and improvement.
- Personal Leadership  - Exhibiting excellent interpersonal skills, charisma, and self-confidence to make an impact on teams, coaching and motivating others, tackling new problems, and advocating strongly for integrity and sensitivity.
- Results Oriented  - Having a GM mindset that focuses on taking decisive action to get things done while finding optimal balance between quality and protecting the bottom-line.

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in relevant field (Marketing, Business, Management, etc.), plus 3-5 years of progressive experience in the CPG or related industry.
- Exceptional organization and project management skills
- Strong writing, presentation and verbal communication skills
- Strong commercial and financial acumen
- Strong data analytics and storytelling skills
- Demonstrated skill in leading strong cross-functional teams; experience managing agency partners
- Demonstrates a genuine desire and passion for the alcohol industry

Preferred Qualifications
- MBA and 1-2 years of brand management experience preferred
- Bilingual (Spanish) preferred
- Experience working with 3rd party data sources (IRI, Nielsen)
- Beverage alcohol related experience a plus

Physical Requirements/Work Environment
- 2 days in office required
- Must be able to sit and/or stand for long periods of time and work on a computer for extended periods. Lifting may be required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
- Travel

Location
Chicago, Illinois
Additional Locations

Job Type
Full time
Job Area
Marketing
The salary range for this role is:
$96,700.00 - $148,100.00
This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  Our compensation is based on cost of labor. For remote locations or positions open to multiple locations, the pay range may reflect several US geographic markets, including the lowest geographic market minimum to the highest geographic market maximum. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, the prevailing minimum wage for the location, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs.  At Constellation Brands, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the high end of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate. We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), and any other benefits to eligible employees.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, or any other form of compensation that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

jobs.title: Human Resources Generalist
jobs.description:
Job Description
Company Summary
-  We’re the producers, creators and marketers of beer, wine and spirts brands that people love. At Constellation Brands, we’re driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver products and experiences that resonate now, tomorrow and well into the future. Because of this approach, we’re the fastest-growing large CPG company in the U.S. at retail, with operations in the U.S., Mexico, New Zealand and Italy. Our premium portfolio of iconic brands like Corona Extra, Modelo Especial, Kim Crawford, Robert Mondavi, Meiomi, The Prisoner, High West Whiskey, and more drive industry-leading growth for us today. But we’re just getting started. Our ability to stay on the forefront of consumer trends has fueled our success since our founding in 1945 and will guide us in creating the next generation of products and experiences Worth Reaching For.

Position Summary
- The Human Resources Generalist serves as the “face of HR” for employees and management, providing consistent, high-quality support across employee relations, labor relations, recruiting, onboarding, compensation, benefits, compliance, engagement, and employee development. This role acts as an employee advocate, HR advisor, and culture builder while supporting the delivery of standard HR processes and talent activities for individual employees and managers.
- Reporting to the HR Manager and partnering closely with HR Business Partners, HR Programs, and specialist teams, the HR Generalist supports site-level HR execution and helps ensure HR policies, programs, and practices are delivered accurately, consistently, and in alignment with company values. Experienced or high-potential HR Generalists may own a client group and continue developing toward the HR Manager role.

Core Accountabilities
Site HR Ownership (Day-to-Day Execution)
- Serve as the primary HR point of contact and trusted advisor for employees and managers regarding HR policies, employment-related questions, employee relations, and people-related matters.
- Manage day-to-day HR activities, including routine and, at times, more complex employee relations matters, investigations, corrective action, discipline, performance management support, and follow-up, escalating high-risk matters as appropriate.
- Complete employee lifecycle activities by location, including onboarding, offboarding, job changes, compensation changes, hiring support, terminations, investigations, employment status updates, and related documentation.
- Prepare, obtain required approvals for, and maintain accurate employee records in the HRIS, including department transfers, salary changes, new hires, terminations, and related reporting in partnership with HRIS and payroll teams.
- Support time and attendance matters, leave administration, disability coordination, benefits-related questions, and the interactive process in partnership with benefits administrators and specialist teams.
- Facilitate and advise on recurring HR programs, including goal setting, performance reviews, talent planning, salary planning, employee development, engagement action planning, and other programmatic HR activities.
- Execute site and functional HR priorities, initiatives, compliance requirements, and training obligations for assigned client groups or locations.

Talent Acquisition & Workforce Support
- Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR Managers, and hiring managers to identify staffing needs, develop or update job descriptions, initiate postings, support interview processes, and help fill roles efficiently and consistently.
- Support recruiting execution, including job postings, interview coordination, background checks, candidate communications, and participation on interview panels as appropriate.
- Ensure a positive, compliant, and effective onboarding experience by working directly with new hires and coaching hiring managers on onboarding expectations.

Employee Experience, Engagement & Culture
- Serve as a visible HR presence and culture builder, developing trusted relationships with employees and leaders at all levels.
- Champion employee engagement, recognition, talent development, survey participation, action planning, and follow-up execution.
- Support local delivery of HR programs and initiatives led by HR Business Partners and HR Programs, including performance management cycles, change initiatives, engagement programs, and compensation-related processes.

Partnership & Collaboration
- Build and maintain strong relationships across the HR team, internal partner groups, client group leaders, and employees across field and home office locations.
- Conduct regular 1:1 meetings with key client group leaders at the Director and/or VP level, as appropriate, to understand business needs and provide HR guidance.
- Partner with HR Managers and HR Business Partners by providing site insights, data, and on-the-ground feedback to inform talent reviews, workforce planning, compensation processes, and business-unit initiatives.
- Run and analyze standard and ad hoc HRIS reports to support HR leadership, decision-making, and data integrity.

Qualifications
- Bilingual English/Spanish skills preferred
- 4–8 years of progressive Human Resources practitioner experience, preferably in a site-based, field HR, or operational HR role
- Bachelor’s degree requiredDemonstrated ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information with discretion
- Strong employee relations, issue resolution, verbal, written, interpersonal, and presentation skills
- Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with minimal supervision
- Ability to be a change agent for key initiatives and work effectively with employees at all levels company-wideHigh-energy, creative, detail-oriented approach with strong analytical ability and follow-through
- Highly proficient in Microsoft Office applications; HRIS experience required, with Workday preferred

Physical Requirements/Work Environment
- Primary work environment is office- and site-based; certain production areas, wineries, warehouses, and vineyards may be cold, wet, slippery, or noisy.
- Approximately 20% travel may be required.
- Occasional lifting up to 25 pounds; additional site-based physical requirements may apply in winery, warehouse, vineyard, or office environments.
- Requires sitting, standing, walking, climbing stairs, operating a computer keyboard, using a telephone and other office equipment, reading, talking, and hearing for extended periods of time.

Location
Paso Robles, California

jobs.title: MBA Marketing Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Job Description
We seek dynamic and motivated Marketing leaders to join our Summer 2027 Beer Marketing Internship team.  This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in brand building through marketing strategy, media, activation and innovation related to our iconic beer brands.

As an MBA Marketing Intern, you will work hand in hand with our teams to lead a Capstone project that tackles a major initiative or business opportunity on your designated team, building a recommendation through a strategic and consumer-focused lens that supports Constellation’s beer marketing objectives. In addition, you may be tasked with additional initiatives and projects related to our business to further develop your skillset across business analysis, storytelling, and brand strategy.  Interns will work in our downtown Chicago office and will be assigned to our brand marketing team- which consists of our Import beer brands, as well as our innovation and new-to-world brands. Successful candidates must be interested in learning how to build brands and consumer-oriented businesses & applying insights into action. You will actively participate and provide perspective on how Constellation can build consumer-oriented brands and expand businesses through innovative thinking while developing a keen understanding of the consumer and strategic marketing plans.

What We Offer:

- A collaborative and inclusive work culture that values diversity and innovation
- Hands-on experience in a fast-paced and dynamic marketing environment
- Ability to work on iconic brands like Corona, Modelo, Pacifico, and Victoria while also building programs that will inform Constellation’s future
- Networking opportunities and mentorship and guidance with professionals across Constellation Brands

Responsibilities

- Complete a robust marketing project based on business needs and make recommendations to marketing leadership team to exhibit strategic, analytical, creative, and professional skills
- Research category trends, competitive activity, and marketing capabilities to inform brand-building and innovation activities
- Assist in the development and execution of marketing campaigns, strategies, and activations
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including other marketing teams, product development, and sales to ensure cohesive brand building
- Work with and manage external agencies who support our marketing and innovation activities
- Participate in brand business analysis, using internal and external data sources to monitor business performance and provide insights for continuous improvement
- Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute creative ideas to enhance brand presence

Key Success Factors

- Passion for understanding drivers of consumer behavior, brand fundamentals, and cultural trends (i.e., sports, music, food, media, art)
- Familiarity with modern approaches to brand building and marketing
- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, turning data and information into actionable insights
- Creative thinker, not intimidated to propose creative innovative ideas to enhance marketing programming, making it more relevant and engaging
- Strong drive for results with an elevated level of organization
- Maintains a positive attitude and contributes to positive company culture outside of day-to-day responsibilities

Minimum Qualifications

- 1st year MBA students with interest in Brand Marketing, Brand Activation, Media, Sports Marketing/Management, or a related field
- Strong interest across varying fields of marketing and the consumer product goods industry, with a base understanding of marketing function roles and responsibilities
- Ability to work in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment in both virtual and in-person form: requiring minimum 2 days in-person at our Beer HQ office in Chicago, IL (Tuesdays + Wednesdays)
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Physical Requirements/Work Environment

- Must be at least 21 years of age
- Must be able to sit and/or stand for prolonged periods and work on a computer for extended periods. Lifting may be required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Chicago, Illinois
